return_rules.lines_428_451: CRSP return compounded with delisting return. Upstream code assigns -0.30 to missing performance-related delisting returns (code 500 or 520-584). This project consumes documented JKP returns; it never invents replacements.
return_rules.lines_454_465: Monthly ret_exc subtracts CRSP t30ret, falling back to French rf, in decimal units.
return_rules.lines_818_825: Lead return is next security observation ret_exc, invalidated when security changes or next ret_lag_dif is not one.

linear_specification.confirmation: User confirmed f(z)=beta_0+beta^T z with intercept and 130 characteristics.

protocol.lambda_rule: Separate frozen grid per representation from its initial 1963-1972 managed-payoff spectrum; 120 effective-complexity-spaced positive penalties.

payoff_sample.order: After formation metadata and 30% characteristic-missingness filters, before monthly ranking and N_t. Characteristic coverage selection remains on the pre-payoff-filter 1963-1972 reference universe.

payoff_sample.audit: Private excluded_returns.csv plus monthly before/after counts; retained payoffs must all be finite.
